variants.name: v11 paw and deltoid
variants.why: the spec's full structure table with existing keys: forearm and wrist thinned so the paw is about 1.5 wrists and wider than the forearm, four wider lobes on a tighter spacing with grooves over the last 40 percent, shorter less bent claws, and an authored deltoid replacing the native flat cap (audit rank 7, R07.1, R07.3, R07.5)
variants.head: head-2271

variants.name: v11 plus claw fan
variants.why: critic 1: claws sit in one column on the inner corner in the front view; the paw is edge-on so move each claw base laterally (along t) by .007 per lobe so the four tips separate across the paw end (R07.5)
variants.head: head-2271

variants.name: v11 plus claw fan reversed
variants.why: sign test of the fan: which way the tips step across the paw end reads as a natural fan in m02 front and forepaw-front; also longer claws .022 to keep at least .008 fit visible beyond the fur
variants.head: head-2271

variants.name: v11 paw only
variants.why: isolates the fist rebuild from the deltoid: keeps the native shoulder cap so R05 stays untouched while R07.3, R07.5 and audit rank 7 are tested alone
variants.head: head-2271

variants.name: deltoid dome only
variants.why: critic 2 and audit rank 13: the upper arm top is a flat slab with a square corner; authored dome of about .035 of figure height radius (larger radii .044 .052 .056) on the v10 arm, to see whether the cap alone fixes R07.1 without arm change
variants.head: head-2271

variants.name: v11 with fallback opening
variants.why: spec friction 3: if removeZ .335 to .385 rounds off the trapezius corner and R05.3 regresses, open only to .320 to .360 and raise the deltoid vertical radius to .056
variants.head: head-2271

variants.name: v11 bigger arched paw
variants.why: audit rank 7 small closed fist: the tip arch should be .80 to .85 of the knuckle width and the dorsum about 1.5 wrists; lobes spread wider and shorter at the outer two with a deeper tip notch, no tip taper key needed
variants.head: head-2271

variants.name: sweep B-23 clawEach.baseOutward=[-0.006, -0.002, 0.002, 0.006]
